basic_details.job_title: BMC Senior Inspector Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Licence Department of the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC, Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai) has invited online applications from eligible serving Licence Inspectors for an online multiple-choice departmental exam for promotion to Senior Inspector (Licence), at Pay Level M-23, Rs. 41800-132300. The online link opened on 26 November 2026 and closes on 16 December 2026 at 24:00:00 on the portal https://portal.mcgm.gov.in. This is a municipal corporation (government body) post, open only to existing BMC Licence Inspectors with at least 5 years' service in that post.

important_dates.online exam: Planned in December 2026; exact date, time, shift and centre to be announced later

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only online. Applications by any other method will not be accepted.

Open the Licence-department link on the BMC portal https://portal.mcgm.gov.in (Service/Staff tab, as given in the notice). The link is active from 26 November 2026 (00:00:01) to 16 December 2026 (24:00:00).
Read the "How to Apply" guidelines published with the circular on the BMC circular pages before filling the form.
Get the service-period certificate (prescribed format) verified and certified by the concerned establishment officer, signed and stamped, and upload it.
Upload the other certificates asked in the form, then print the completed application and keep it with you.
Give a clear, complete e-mail ID and mobile number, and do not change them until the exam is over.

For doubts while filling the form, the notice gives helpline numbers 18002222366 / 18001034566 (10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday to Friday except public holidays) and a grievance link, http://cgrs.ibps.in.
Service-period certificate in the prescribed format (name, date of appointment as Licence Inspector, service completed up to 01.11.2026)
Marathi qualification certificate (SSC/HSC marksheet with Marathi, or BMC Marathi exam pass certificate)
MS-CIT / GECT or DOEACC CCC/O/A/B/C certificate
UDID disability certificate, for candidates with disabilities
Caste certificate and caste validity certificate, where applicable
Gazette copy or affidavit for a change of name; marriage certificate for married women whose name changed
Educational qualification proof, PAN card and Aadhaar card, as asked in the application form
important_instructions: Admit cards are downloaded from www.mcgm.gov.in; the link is sent by e-mail/SMS. Roll number or registration number, and password or date of birth, are needed. Report at the exam centre about 1 hour before the time printed on the admit card; candidates arriving after that time will not be allowed to sit. Carry the original admit card, the original BMC ID card with photo and an attested copy of it. Women whose name changed must carry the gazette or marriage certificate with attested copy. Mobile phones, calculators, books and other communication devices are prohibited in the exam hall. Candidates attend at their own risk. Exam centre, venue, date or session changes are not entertained; the organiser may change centres or add centres. Candidates absent without reason will be fined Rs. 1000/-. Candidates with disabilities who need a scribe must register this in the online form and submit Appendix I, II and III as the circular states. They get 20 extra minutes per hour; the notice also gives separate rules for visually impaired candidates. Ineligible or false information will lead to cancellation of the application or disqualification at any stage of promotion.

content_sections.heading: About BMC Licence Department Recruitment
content_sections.text: The circular is issued by the Licence Department (Anuagyapan Khata) of the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation. It follows the approval of the Municipal Commissioner (No. MGC/F/5044 dated 17.12.2024) and the revised exam scheme proposed by the General Administration Department (No. MPM/2/4258 dated 12.03.2025). The post of Senior Inspector (Licence) is filled from Licence Inspectors who pass the department's online exam.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only serving BMC Licence Inspectors who meet the following conditions can apply. The notice does not print an age limit. Candidates who are not exempt and have been given a specific period to obtain the computer certificate must obtain it within that period. The service-period certificate in the notice is counted up to 01.11.2026. Candidates must check the circular for any further conditions on eligibility. Candidates serving in posts reserved for a different category, or whose proposals are pending, should read clause 9.6 of the circular, which makes the establishment officer responsible for checking eligibility.

rows.details: Minimum 5 years working as Licence Inspector in the BMC Licence Department
Passed SSC/HSC or an equivalent or higher exam with Marathi as a subject (100-mark paper); otherwise must pass the BMC Marathi language exam under the prescribed policy
MS-CIT or GECT certificate, or DOEACC Society CCC / O / A / B / C level certificate, unless exempt for another reason

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries Pay Level M-23 with a revised pay scale of Rs. 41800-132300 under the Seventh Pay Commission. The notice mentions no allowances or tenure terms.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is by a multiple-choice objective online exam on computer. It is a qualifying test only. The final result is prepared on the basis of marks by an outside agency, and posts are filled in order of seniority from those who pass. The notice does not mention an interview. The time allowed for all parts together is 100 minutes, and candidates may attempt questions of any part in that time. Candidates must score at least 50% in each of Parts A, B and C. There is no negative marking. Exemptions earned in earlier exams are not counted, and all candidates must attempt the full paper. English grammar is tested in English and the other subjects in Marathi.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BMC Senior Inspector (Licence)?
faq.answer: The last date for the online application is 16 December 2026 at 24:00:00. The link opened on 26 November 2026 at 00:00:01.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for the BMC Senior Inspector (Licence) exam?
faq.answer: Serving BMC Licence Inspectors with at least 5 years' service as Licence Inspector in the BMC Licence Department, who also meet the Marathi and computer requirements.

faq.question: Q3. What is the pay of Senior Inspector (Licence) in BMC?
faq.answer: The post is at Pay Level M-23, with a revised pay scale of Rs. 41800-132300 under the Seventh Pay Commission.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online only, through the Licence-department link on the BMC portal https://portal.mcgm.gov.in, and upload the certified service-period certificate and other documents. No other mode is accepted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the exam pattern?
faq.answer: The exam is an online multiple-choice test of 100 questions and 100 marks in 100 minutes, with Parts A (60), B (20) and C (20). Passing needs at least 50% in each part.

faq.question: Q6. Is there negative marking?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that negative marking will not be used.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any Marathi requirement?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates need SSC/HSC or an equivalent or higher exam with a 100-mark Marathi paper, or must pass the BMC Marathi language exam under its policy.

faq.question: Q8. Is a computer certificate required?
faq.answer: Yes, unless exempt. MS-CIT or GECT, or a DOEACC Society CCC/O/A/B/C level certificate, is required.

faq.question: Q9. When will the exam be held?
faq.answer: The notice says the exam is planned in December 2026; the exact date, time, shift and centre will be announced later.

faq.question: Q10. What happens if I miss the exam?
faq.answer: Candidates absent without reason will be fined Rs. 1000/-.
